system.description:
Starting at 3rd level, your every strike flows like choreography, weaving battle into a performance. To you, the clash of steel is no different than music, and combat is your dance floor. When you choose the Battle Dancer Doctrine, your utilization of weapons that you can move gracefully with is a beautiful symphony to onlookers.

While you are in combat, you can spend a Bonus action on your turn, to enter one of two different Dances; Samba or Waltz

Waltz

Battle Amp

You perform a smooth dance filled with elegant steps, but you can’t do it alone. You require a Partner. At the beginning of your turn, you select a Partner. A partner is a willing creature whom you can see and they remain your Partner until the beginning of your next turn. You can only have 1 Partner at a time.

When you begin your turn within 10 feet of your willing partner you both gain the following benefits;

Move in Tandem. If you or your Partner goes first in the turn order, either of you can, spend 1 Discipline to allow the other to take their turn at the same time, on the same initiative count this round. When their turn comes up in the initiative count, it is skipped until the next round. If a Partner without access to Discipline uses this ability, they can spend 1 of the Weapon specialists Discipline to use this ability.

Battle Step. In place of your movement, you and your partner, select two spaces adjacent to each other that either of you can reach with your movement and perform an aggressive maneuver, moving to the chosen spaces. This spends all of the users movement.

Cascade Step. When you take the Attack action or cast a jutsu that requires an attack, you can spend 1 Discipline to force the affected creature to make a Dexterity saving throw vs the Weapon Specialists Taijutsu Save DC. On a failure, they suffer a -2 penalty to their AC until the beginning of your next turn. If a Partner without access to Discipline uses this ability, they can spend 1 of the Weapon specialists Discipline to use this ability.

Defensive Dance. When you or your Partner take damage you can spend your Reaction and 2 Discipline to gain resistance to the triggering damage. If a Partner without access to Discipline uses this, they can instead spend their reaction and 1 of the Weapon specialists Discipline to use this ability.

You can dance in this way for the duration of Combat and can end early at no action on your turn. You can spend a Bonus action to switch your dance.
